2607.00747.title: Active Learning for Cascaded Object Detection: Balancing Coverage and Uncertainty in Table Extraction Pipelines
2607.00747.paper_summary: Table extraction from business documents relies on a cascaded pipeline where Table Detection (TD) first localizes tables and Table Structure Recognition (TSR) then recovers their internal layout. Building task-specific training sets for this pipeline is costly, particularly for TSR which requires fine-grained structural annotations. Active learning (AL) can reduce this annotation burden, yet most AL strategies are designed for single-model tasks and do not account for inter-stage dependencies in cascaded architectures. In this work, we present the first adaptation of Uncertainty Herding (UHerding), a hybrid coverage-uncertainty sampling method originally proposed for image classification, to cascaded object detection pipelines. We propose two pipeline-aware extensions that exploit the TD-to-TSR dependency: RankFusion adds dual-manifold coverage over both detection and structure representation spaces, while CAPA further incorporates stage-dependent gating and per-task uncertainty calibration. Extensive experiments across two public (PubTables-1M and FinTabNet) and two private table extraction datasets, with various annotation budgets (from 71 to 500 documents) show that UHerding generalizes well to table extraction, outperforming each baseline. Among pipeline-aware variants, RankFusion achieves higher expected gains but at the cost of greater variance, while CAPA emerges as the most consistent strategy, outperforming standard UHerding on three out of four datasets.
2607.00747.paper_summary_zh: 表格提取自商業文件依賴於一個級聯管道，其中表格檢測（TD）首先定位表格，然後表格結構識別（TSR）恢復其內部佈局。為這個管道構建特定任務的訓練集是昂貴的，特別是對於TSR，因為它需要細緻的結構標註。主動學習（AL）可以減少這一標註負擔，但大多數AL策略是為單一模型任務設計的，並未考慮級聯架構中的階段間依賴性。在這項工作中，我們首次將不確定性驅動（UHerding）適應於級聯物體檢測管道，這是一種最初為圖像分類提出的混合覆蓋-不確定性抽樣方法。我們提出了兩個管道感知擴展，利用TD到TSR的依賴性：RankFusion在檢測和結構表示空間上添加了雙流形覆蓋，而CAPA進一步結合了階段依賴的閘控和每任務的不確定性校準。在兩個公共（PubTables-1M和FinTabNet）和兩個私人表格提取數據集上進行的廣泛實驗，涵蓋了各種標註預算（從71到500份文件），顯示UHerding在表格提取上具有良好的泛化能力，超越了每個基準。在管道感知變體中，RankFusion實現了更高的預期增益，但代價是更大的方差，而CAPA則成為最一致的策略，在四個數據集中有三個超越了標準的UHerding。
